---
title: "Hex wall"
description: "Layout demo: tiling the section hex stickers into a honeycomb."
---

A layout test. The three existing stickers, repeated, tiled as a point-up honeycomb. Rows step down three quarters of a hex height and alternate rows shift half a hex width, so the stickers' own inked borders meet with a hairline gap.

```{=html}
<div class="hexwall">
<div class="hexrow">
<img src="www/hex/research.png" alt="Research hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/projects.png" alt="Projects hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/left-hand-thoughts.png" alt="Left-hand Thoughts hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/research.png" alt="Research hex sticker">
</div>
<div class="hexrow">
<img src="www/hex/projects.png" alt="Projects hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/left-hand-thoughts.png" alt="Left-hand Thoughts hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/research.png" alt="Research hex sticker">
</div>
<div class="hexrow">
<img src="www/hex/projects.png" alt="Projects hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/left-hand-thoughts.png" alt="Left-hand Thoughts hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/research.png" alt="Research hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/projects.png" alt="Projects hex sticker">
</div>
<div class="hexrow">
<img src="www/hex/left-hand-thoughts.png" alt="Left-hand Thoughts hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/research.png" alt="Research hex sticker">
<img src="www/hex/projects.png" alt="Projects hex sticker">
</div>
</div>
```
